proof: If s is S3-fixed and f is equivariant, then f(s)=f(g*s)=g*f(s) for every g in S3.
Thus f(s) would have to be a global S3-fixed point of the donor branch set.
The natural S3 action on three donors is transitive and has no global fixed donor; contradiction.
theorem: At a local input fixed by the full transverse S3 action, no deterministic stateless S3-equivariant map into B1={X2,X3,X4} exists.
